units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:4">Yeb. VIII, 4</cite> <he>סְרִיס אדם</he> one emasculated by man, a castrate, opp. to <he>סְ׳ חמה</he>, v. <cite ref="H01152"><he>חַמָּה</he></cite>.
Ib. 80ᵃ יביאו ראיה … והוא הס׳ they shall bring evidence that he is twenty years old (without showing the symptoms of maturity), and this is the legal saris.
Ib. נעשה ס׳ למפרע he is considered as having been a saris at the time of the deed (and legally responsible), opp. קטן.

<cite ref="Yevamot 80a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>סימני ס׳ וכ׳</he> persons with the symptoms of impotency … are not legally proceeded against (as responsible persons) until they are twenty years of age; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>סָרִיסִים</he>, <he>סָרִיסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 93b:15">Snh. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ ממש</he> real castrates (<cite ref="O01620"><he>סריס</he></cite> in the real sense).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:6">Deut. R. s. 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01571"><he>סָרַח</he> II</cite>; a. e.—[
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3">Num. R. s. 11</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:7:3">Cant. R. to III, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00564"><he>מוּפְלָא</he></cite>.]
